g.title: crate Value lowering, resource resolution and local scene adaptation.
crate::assets UI-local image and font resources with located failure histories.
crate::border Borders, shadows and the focus ring of a box.
crate::context What painting a scene or a fill needs besides the scene itself.
crate::conversion Semantic conversion of wire values to neutral text and geometry.
crate::effects A node's effects as Arvane values: tint, layers and backdrop.
crate::fill Fills: background layers and CSS gradients as Arvane paints.
crate::glyphs Painting of text nodes and scene text runs with their decorations.
crate::path Transforms and offsets shared geometry for painting.
crate::sanitize CSS paint correction and graceful local-command adaptation.
crate::scene Flattening of node-local canvas scenes into global draw commands.
crate::scene::geometry Lowering of local scene geometry commands.
crate::scene::layers Lowering of local scene layers commands.
crate::scene::paint Paint one node's scene: reuse its cached lowering or lower each command.
crate::scene::raster Lowering of local scene raster commands.
crate::scene::state The groups one local scene lowering has open in the output.
crate::scene::text Lowering of local scene text commands.
crate::scene_cache Bounded retained local scene payloads and resource dependency data.
crate::scene_out An append-only output scene that knows how many groups are open in it.
crate::scene_shape Canvas geometry is lowered once for drawing, culling and region hits.
crate::shape Box, padding box and clip path shapes shared by painting and hit testing.
